title: In-air scale test at 480 volts showing about 1 millinewton of thrust

tellings.quote: We see about 0.1 g. That corresponds to about 1 mill of thrust.

plain: In a lab in Florida run by a company called Exodus Propulsion, a device placed on a scale and powered at 480 volts showed a reading of about 0.1 grams, which Charles Buhler says "corresponds to about 1 mill of thrust", meaning about one millinewton of push. Buhler, an engineer billed as a former NASA chief, tells it first-hand and points to a 42-minute video of the test, which he presents as a sign of propulsion without fuel.
